narr: Slow moving thunderstorms produced localized flash flooding across the area.
ev: South Walton fire reported several flooded roadways in the southern part of the county.
The Gray Lily Farm driveway washed out due to heavy rain in a short period of time on Saturday evening. A nearby CoCoRaHS station measured 3.78 inches of rain, most of which fell in 1 to 2 hours.
